blocks.html:
VINYL WRAP TORONTO’S LIST OF INTERESTING OBJECT WRAPS

When we say we can wrap anything, we’re not kidding and our customers know it. Although Vinyl Wrap Toronto is a vehicle wrap agency, we like to dabble into wrapping all kinds of objects. Objects that are priceless to our customers, objects they intend to gift, objects they want to customize, etc. Every now and then we receive a request from a customer asking us to wrap something that would be considered unusual for an agency that wraps vehicles. We appreciate our customers greatly, who deem us qualified to wrap their personal objects and we do the job with perfection to assure them that they made the right decision.

Now, when it comes to objects, we all know there could be countless objects or equipment. What people choose to get wrapped is their personal choice and we respect that. It gives us immense pleasure to get the opportunity to wrap these objects and equipment. Every request we get for wrapping an object is another opportunity for us to learn and expand our skillset. Our installers are always looking for interesting wraps to do. Being able to make a customer happy is what keeps us going and trying new things.

Speaking of objects, today we’re listing down some of the most interesting object wrap requests we received from our clients.

  • An Urn: Yes, you read that right. One of our creative customers asked us to wrap an Urn. The customer had recently experienced a loss of a loved one and they wanted to do something special with the urn that was going to be holding that loved one forever. The customer wanted to wrap the urn with something sentimental to express their love towards the loved one who just moved on. We think it was a beautiful gesture and we took the job with an open heart. The customer was incredibly pleased to get the urn wrapped exactly as they envisioned. Everyone can agree that being able to soothe the pain of a grieving soul is something that makes us connect on a deeper human level. Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we appreciate that our customers think of us to do something so touching and personal.
  • A Murphy Bed: Now that’s something you don’t see every day, a wrapped murphy bed. Although Murphy beds are supposed to be saving space, and they do it very well, yet you can’t help but notice a big thing stuck to your wall. Most people won’t be bothered by it but some who pay attention to detail would find a creative way to make it seem natural. That’s exactly what this customer wanted. They had a few bookshelves at their place and a Murphy bed. They believed the murphy bed looked a bit odd, so they wanted it to blend in with the rest of the interior. So, this customer had an idea that they want to wrap the bottom of the Murphy Bed with a wrap that looks like a bookshelf. It was a brilliant idea. Without a doubt, we took the job and made her vision come true. After the wrap, the bed blended in perfectly.
  • High Heel Shoes: Oftentimes, when people are going out with their squad in a party mode, personalizing their heels is the last thing on their minds. However, it does not mean you can’t be creative. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has proved that we can wrap objects even as small as a pair of heels. Who knew you could use the real estate on your heels to express yourself? This was one of those creative ideas that we couldn’t refuse.
  • Wifi Boxes: Are you trying to camouflage or blend an object into the background? We wrapped wifi boxes that were being installed at the Distillery District. The client did not want the boxes which were being placed on the outside of buildings to be an eyesore. The company supplied us with the paint colour of the buildings and we colour-matched and then wrapped the wifi boxes. Now unless you look for the boxes, they should be nearly invisible.
  • Stove Hood Air Vent: When you know you’re going to be spending a significant amount in your kitchen, it’s natural to want to personalize it with what pleases your eye. A client wanted to get their Stove Hood Air Vent wrapped in black to complement their kitchen interior. So, instead of paying a lot for it, they decided to get a wrap would be a far better choice, considering the lifetime, price, and ability to change back. This is the kind of outside-the-box thinking we love to be a part of.
  • Guitar: Got a guitar sitting in your room that could use a bit of vinyl goodness? We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto are here to make that happen. Recently a customer came to us with a guitar that they thought looked dull and boring. So, they wanted to give it a personal touch by getting their favourite cartoon character on it. It was a character named “Blinky” from the popular animated TV show, ”The Simpsons”. It was an interesting choice and certainly made the guitar more vibrant and appealing.
  • Mackbook Pro: A computer is something that people end up using very often if not every day. For some people, it does not matter what the back of their laptop looks like. However, not everyone is the same and some may want to personalize it with their favorite graphic. Often times we get requested by our customers to wrap their laptops and we take on the job with an open mind. The choice of graphics and design varies from customer to customer. Vinyl Wrap Toronto appreciates getting the chance to be able to provide our customers with what makes them happy.
  • Scooter: With time people are getting to the realization that if there’s anything that gives full freedom to go wild with their imagination, it’s a vinyl wrap job. The possibilities are endless. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’ve wrapped scooters for our clients. It is not as common for people to get their scooter wrapped, but when we get asked for it, we make sure we say a big yes and do a terrific job.

So, those were some of the most interesting objects we’ve wrapped at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. The objects no vehicle wrap agency usually gets into. Either because of their inexperience or some other reason. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we like to give it our best shot before we give up on something. And almost every time, we have outdone ourselves with the new challenges we receive. Vinyl Wrap Toronto encourages people to contact us for any kind of object wrap. Experts here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto would love to discuss your requirements and make it happen for you.

Check out some of the benefits of getting a vehicle wrap here.

Read: Object Wrap; Personalize your everyday objects with a design of your choice.

We mean it when we say we can wrap anything that has a smooth surface. It could be anything such as vending machines, toolboxes, house walls, etc. If you have something close to you that could use a personal touch of your own, feel free to contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to speak to our expert designers and make your vision come to life.
